text.en: Several long-term clients appreciate the accommodating approach of the groomers and their willingness to assist during urgent situations. However, other pet owners express dissatisfaction, citing dismissive phone interactions and unhelpful attitudes when addressing scheduling or service queries.

Regular patrons frequently commend the standard of haircuts and de-shedding baths, noting that their dogs return looking well presented. Conversely, one client reported severe skin irritation and burns following a grooming appointment, advising caution for pets with delicate coats.

Reviewers note that the salon can accommodate same-day emergency washes when dogs encounter mishaps like skunk encounters. On the other hand, another client faced prolonged waiting periods of over five hours without updates or completion of a booked puppy trim.

q.en: Can the salon accommodate urgent pet wash appointments?

a.en: Yes, clients report that the salon has accommodated urgent requests, such as washing a dog after a skunk encounter.

q.en: Do clients find the grooming fees reasonable?

a.en: Several regular reviewers consider the pricing fair and reasonable for bathing and breed-specific grooming treatments.

q.en: Are cats groomed at Grooming By Gloria?

a.en: The business offers bathing and grooming options for both dogs and cats by prior appointment.
